confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rest on a few aggregated guides and a crowd-sourced estimate, so they are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine anchors are weak: they come from crowd-sourced bottle and per-person spend figures, with the glass and cocktail values set by the local beer relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Alcohol is licensed, so bar and restaurant drink prices vary widely. FX is the RBA observation for 2026-10-15 as shown in search results; I did not open the RBA page directly, and a third-party 16 October figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gulf city with licensed alcohol limited to hotels, restaurants and clubs. Restaurant and drink anchors follow Muscat-specific sources (OMR figures converted at the pegged rate of about 2.6 USD per OMR). Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Gulf capital with limited registered hostel supply.
